title: Shimla Manali Kasol Tour Package
overview: Planning a holiday in Himachal Pradesh but finding it difficult to choose the right places? A Shimla Manali Kasol tour package can give you a mix of beautiful hill stations, peaceful valleys, adventure activities, and memorable mountain experiences in one trip. With Safar Trails, a trusted Tour and Travel Agency, you can explore the charm of Shimla, the adventurous side of Manali, and the peaceful atmosphere of Kasol with a thoughtfully planned itinerary. Whether you are travelling with family, friends, your partner, or a group, we can help you plan a comfortable and enjoyable Himachal trip.
highlights: Dedicated Private Cab from Delhi and back for all transfers & sightseeing
Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing (The Ridge, Mall Road, Christ Church, Jakhu Temple)
Manali Local Sightseeing (Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht, Van Vihar, Old Manali)
Solang Valley, engineering marvel Atal Tunnel & excursion to Sissu in Lahaul Valley
Kasol & Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara (hot springs) & Chalal riverside village walk
Daily breakfast and on-trip travel assistance
All toll, parking, and driver allowances included
inclusions: Transportation by private vehicle from Delhi and back
Pickup and drop-off at Delhi / Chandigarh
Local sightseeing across Shimla, Kufri, Manali, Solang, Sissu, Kasol, and Manikaran
Driver charges, fuel, toll and parking charges
Meal plans (Daily breakfast, with dinner options)
exclusions: Additional activities and adventure activities (paragliding, rafting, zorbing)
Entry tickets and monument/park attraction charges
Meals not mentioned in the package
Expenses due to unexpected weather or road conditions
Special sightseeing requirements or additional services

itinerary.title: Delhi → Shimla | Scenic Drive & Mall Road
itinerary.description: Depart from Delhi by private cab and drive into the scenic foothills of the Himalayas. Arrival in Shimla, hotel check-in and evening visit to The Ridge, Mall Road & Christ Church. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Kufri, Green Valley, Jakhu Temple on the hill crest, and enjoy free time in the evening at Mall Road. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla → Manali | Scenic Valley Transfer
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through the Himalayan valleys along the Beas and Satluj rivers. Check-in at your hotel in Manali and enjoy the evening at leisure along Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing | Hadimba & Old Manali
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Temple surrounded by cedar forests, Manu Temple in Old Manali, Vashisht Village with its sulphur baths, Van Vihar nature park & Old Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali → Solang Valley → Atal Tunnel → Sissu → Kasol
itinerary.description: Enjoy scenic Himalayan views at Solang Valley, drive through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul to see Sissu waterfall, followed by a picturesque mountain journey to Kasol in Parvati Valley. Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol & Manikaran Sightseeing | Chalal Village
itinerary.description: Visit Manikaran Sahib gurudwara and natural thermal hot springs, and explore the peaceful pine-trail to Chalal Village. Spend the evening at leisure at Kasol Market and riverside cafés. Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol → Delhi | Departure
itinerary.description: Check out and begin your return journey to Delhi by private cab, enjoying scenic valley views along the way. Trip Ends with unforgettable Himachal memories.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Shimla, Manali and Kasol?
faqs.answer: Summer (March to June) is ideal for pleasant weather, green valley views, and sightseeing. Monsoon (July to September) offers lush landscapes though road conditions should be checked. Winter (October to February) is great for snow seekers, especially around Solang Valley and Sissu.

faqs.question: Who can book this Himachal tour?
faqs.answer: This package is suitable for families, couples, friends, solo travellers, corporate groups, and private travel groups. Safar Trails customizes the itinerary and vehicle (sedan, SUV, or tempo traveller) based on your group size.

faqs.question: Can I customize the Shimla Manali Kasol tour package?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can discuss your preferred travel dates, hotel categories (3★, 4★, boutique cottages), vehicle preference, and specific places you want to add or spend extra time in.

faqs.question: Are the Atal Tunnel and Rohtang Pass included?
faqs.answer: The Atal Tunnel and Sissu waterfall are included on Day 5. Rohtang Pass can be added where accessible depending on the season, weather conditions, and local union permit rules.

faqs.question: How much does the 7D/6N Shimla Manali Kasol package cost?
faqs.answer: This comprehensive 7-day/6-night package starts at approximately ₹15,999 per person (₹30,000–₹35,000 per couple) including 6 nights hotel stays, private cab for all 7 days from Delhi, daily breakfast, and sightseeing.
